assumptions: Each sample is an independent module; sample files must not be concatenated.
Every complete .lang file begins with package main; in these independent examples; imports follow the package declaration.
An explicitly declared enum may be used as a throws error type without a separate Error trait implementation in this draft.
Result and Option are ordinary type names rather than reserved unwrapping syntax.
02_generics.lang defines its own Ordered trait and instantiates less only for i32; its generic function returns bool rather than a borrowed generic value.
Vec[T] is the proposed standard vector type; list literals may obtain their element type from context.
Default integer and floating literals are i64 and f64 when no more specific context applies.
std/py is a language bridge module; its import is not translated into an ordinary Python import of std.py.
The Python sample requires reviewed bindings plus installed NumPy and PyTorch packages.
inout parameter syntax is name inout Type; the call syntax is inout expression.
No example establishes complete ARC, lifetime, move-only, or foreign mutation semantics.

positive_examples.expected_behavior: main returns 0; squared distance is 25.0 and final counter is 10
less[i32] compares values while the loop finds 9 in [4, 9, 2]; main returns 0
negative input is caught; two Result values remain ordinary data with one success and one error; main returns 0
train performs 200 SGD updates on y = 2*x + 1 and returns the real scalar loss Tensor without implicit item/detach/cpu/numpy conversion
sum_until_zero returns 5 and cleanup_count becomes 1; main returns 0
function value returns 6; returned callback succeeds on 3 and its negative-input error is caught; main returns 0

negative_examples.reason: binding declaration is missing its terminating semicolon
a positional argument follows a named argument
a nonthrowing function neither catches nor declares the called function's error
a string is assigned to i32
Result[i32, Problem] is not implicitly unwrapped to i32, including inside a throws function
defer cleanup cannot propagate an unhandled recoverable error
a function used as a return type must be parenthesized to disambiguate throws ownership
